rules: File inventory, AST parsing, source disclosure and test execution are different evidence levels.
No historical path/blob version inherits current-version review.
No subsystem assigned AUDIT_COMPLETE where experiments/fixtures/agent use remain unresolved.
No runtime, architecture or backlog authority is created by this census.

method.tree: git for-each-ref; git ls-remote origin; git ls-tree -rlz <each distinct tip>
method.history: git log --all --root -m --raw -z --format=@%H --no-renames --no-abbrev; git rev-list --objects --all; git cat-file --batch-check
method.calls: Python AST import binding plus conservative package reexport resolution; manually trace application/Tool dispatch separately.
method.verification: Native managed Commands, current immutable Git objects; no source-tree copy, checkout, worktree, clone, inference or scientific replay.

limitations: Internal unreachable Git objects/reflogs are not source authority and are outside all-reachable-ref census.
Historical code versions and non-RI domains are inventoried, not substantively reviewed.
Recorded remote advertisement may gain later commits; publication must reauthenticate.
No general effectiveness conclusion from source or scripted tests.
